style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium tech ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of matte deep teal #2B4A47, warm cream #F7EADB, charcoal #2A2A2E with one gold-orange accent #E39A5F and near-white text #FFFFFF; neutral temperature with warm gold highlights; modern geometric sans-serif typography with Chinese in-image text wrapped in 「」; backgrounds alternate between deep-teal textured panels, warm cream soft-wave panels, charcoal dark scenes and clean near-white areas; soft diffused studio lighting with front-left key, gentle warm rim light and soft contact shadows; rounded rectangular cards with 24px corner radius, thin gold-line circular icons and thin dashed separators; stable centered product presentation at a consistent slight 3/4 hero angle with believable contact shadows; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
